policies.description: Before invoking link_new_incident_sla, ensure that all required fields (incident_id, sla_def_id, start_time) are provided and non‑empty, because any create request must validate mandatory fields.
references: Mandatory Fields: Any request to create or update a record must validate all mandatory fields.

policies.description: The SLA to be linked must correspond to the incident’s priority, as SLAs are automatically aligned based on the incident’s priority.
references: SLA Application: SLAs are automatically aligned based on priority linked to the incident.

policies.description: If the incident is currently on hold with a reason of Awaiting Change, Awaiting Caller, or Awaiting Problem, the new SLA record should be created with stage set to paused rather than the default in_progress.
references: SLA Pause: The SLA timer must be paused (stage = paused) when the Incident is in stage = on_hold and the on_hold_reason is one of the following enumerations: Awaiting Change, Awaiting Caller, or Awaiting Problem.

policies.description: Verify that the invoking user’s role has authority to create an incident SLA; if the role lacks permission, the operation must be halted with a 403 Forbidden error.
references: 403 Forbidden: Permission denied (user role lacks authority for the operation).

policies.description: Linking a new incident SLA must be performed as a single validated operation, not combined with other actions.
references: Atomic Operations: Perform one validated operation at a time, except when using approved batch endpoints.
